description: The integer written by balanced ternary digits, where T means -1. "0" is 0, "T" is -1, "1T" is 2, "10" is 3, and "1TT" is 5. A bad digit or a leading zero is rejected. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ternary-value
